sql: SELECT o.id, o.kalshi_order_id, o.client_order_id, o.status, o.side, o.action, o.limit_price, o.quantity, o.created_at::text, o.event_ticker, left(o.raw_order_json::text, 700) AS raw, (SELECT count(*) FROM fills f WHERE f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id) AS fills, (SELECT count(*) FROM live_order_queue_ticks t WHERE t.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id) AS ticks, (SELECT max(t.captured_at)::text FROM live_order_queue_ticks t WHERE t.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id) AS last_tick, (SELECT max(t.contracts_ahead) FROM live_order_queue_ticks t WHERE t.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id) AS max_ahead FROM live_orders o WHERE o.kalshi_order_id='01a0799b-8b40-7b41-b051-7363555c04aa'
